Fes was one of my favorite cities I visited during my trip to Morocco (I can’t pick one favorite, I loved them all 🥹❤️🇲🇦). It’s known as the cultural capital and is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Founded all the way back in the 9th century, it’s one of the oldest continuously inhabited cities in the world! The streets are made for walking, and most of the main sites are located close to one another. You only need about two days to explore, but those two days will be unforgettable as you watch artisans make Argan oil, handwoven carpets, and beautiful leather goods right in front of you. I still use the Argan oil I bought here and it has done wonders to my hair! #fes #morocco #unescoworldheritagesite #travelblog #travelguide #travelmorocco #historicalcity
